source_definition_review: The official all-county table labels its numerator Voter Turnout and its denominator Eligible Active Registered Voters. The official FAQ defines turnout in relation to ballot casting by eligible registered voters. This supports a source-defined registered fraction, not demographic, CVAP/VAP/VEP or complete certified all-ballot turnout.
